answer: Decaying identity bonds block fake identities. A new agent posts a 100-coin bond shrinking 5% each epoch, like a glacier losing mass, unless work refreshes it. Bonds sit on a marble record showing age and history. Fresh, unlinked identities form a nebula with no shared history, so auditors freeze suspect bonds. Forging 1,000 identities costs 100,000 coins, and idle copies keep losing value. An honest agent pays once and keeps rewards undiluted.
